reviews_data.review_text: Great neighborhood spot, friendly dogs and nice humans.

Why are there not more spots like this in Charlotte?!Franks truly encapsulates “local” and I wish more places could capture that feel.

We came for the Metzgers bagels and stayed for the coffee and vibe. Such an enjoyable experience watching the revolving door of neighbors coming in. Everyone was treated as if they knew them for a long time. Big energy and lots of dogs. Left saying I wish we had something like this in our neighborhood.
Great fun environment perfect for couples and dog lovers. Just needs more seating
Such a fun local bar in Charlotte! Great company, live music and food trucks during the weekend!
One thing that has always stood out to me is how authentic and friendly they are.  Really cool place, great atmosphere.
Great neighbour!

We're spoiled living right next to Vaulted Oak but delighted to have discovered & visited this little nook yesterday with our dogs.  This makes for a nice walkable(braving a Briar Creek crossing) neighborhood hangout with a really cool vibe.  I noticed a coffee machine behind the counter- so I wonder if it's a cool-vibe coffee house by day too?   We JUST missed an oyster roast- but just the fact they had one at all prompts 5 stars from me.
Welcoming friendly cozy atmosphere, nice to pop in for a cute dog and a beer.
Had a great time! Great neighborhood bar!
Great spot, needs more parking
Great spot, I had a few drinks while dealing with an ordeal at golden piston auto shop
I was here for the first time on a Sunday. I got a strawberry vanilla iced latte that was delicious. I LOVE all the dogs! That was the highlight for me. Can't wait for a return visit.
Joe is this man
BEST neighborhood bar! Great location to walk to, incredible owner and bartenders, and amazing service every single visit. We’ll continue to come back weekly! Can’t wait to bring my dog with me.

200sq/ft inside at most...I have closets bigger than this place.  Too many barking dogs and kids under 5.  Its in a neighborhood, so that's why so many 5 star reviews from them.  Bring your double stroller, everybody else does.  Staff overwhelmed if more than 10 people are there.  Not sure staff has ever worked as a bartender before. Not a place to watch sports or TV.  Good news, Miguel next door can get you 4 used tires and a muffler while you wait 20 min for a beer. If you live in walking distance, this is your spot, if you need to drive, you are parking in front of someones house who may yell at you.
reviews_data.owner_answer: thanks for stopping by! we got packed out today for an event supporting a local dog rescue and a lot of people showed up to support. sorry it was inconvenient for you.

reviews_data.review_text: A wonderful place to grab a beer and hug dogs. It was touching to learn the shop is named after the owner's dog, Frank. I look forward to returning soon. A huge thank you for hosting the Country Acres Rescue adoption event. It was a huge success.
Name a better spot. I will wait.
Little small but pretty cool. We'll be back.
Great vibe, friendly staff, we will be back
Good beer, great people, the best dogs.
World-class neighborhood bar.
Very cool beer store and bar.  It's small but people are always here.  Additionally, they have collaborations with multiple breweries. Food got no stars, simply because I've never eaten here.
Went for the music, it's a small space but the music level was perfect.  Bartender created a friendly vibe and the whole crowd was chill.  It was great!
Such a great beer shop! Great selection, super friendly staff, very cozy. My new favorite local spot!
Fantastic beer shop! They make their own blonde in house and have a wide variety of options available. Highly recommend.
Low key space with a friendly staff. Good selection of beer with a welcoming environment.  Definitely will be back soon and often

I visited Franks Beer shop last weekend.. did a little pony spaghett day drinkies with my friends. This place is so very adorable. All the drinks are very well curated.. they serve my favorite beers from local breweries. Even the art on the walls are hung with intention.  It’s the perfect neighborhood bar with the perfect neighborhood price. We definitely will be back.

What a nice, cozy spot! The perfect size and delightfully, friendly atmosphere, this community-driven beer shop has everything you might possibly need. The vibes were immaculate. The beer was tasty. I fully enjoyed my visit and will be frequenting more in the future. Also, dogs. Lots of dogs. Frank's gives back to the rescue community and supports the animals that need it the most. Need I say more?
We had a blast. Great beer choices. Grateful Dead tunes, friendly crowd. Joe is awesome
Love this place 100% recommend. Love the energy love the staff.
Great for dogs and a great brew!
Awesome new neighborhood spot! Great beer, kind people, and lots of dogs.
Good beer, chill aesthetic, cool owner, all around good vibes. Lovely patrons as well (often including some great dogs!); stop by for a drink and leave with some new friends!

What a neighborhood gem!!! So cool to read about Joe's story of opening this little local watering hole. He's thought through everything too - they've got an excellent selection of local draft beers, plus high quality wines, canned drinks (beers/seltzers/etc.) and even some light snacks. The card games are a nice touch, too, and Joe couldn't be more friendly. Already can't wait to come back (and bring our pup - they're dog friendly inside and out!).

We visited for the first time and had a great experience! It was bustling with locals and had a great energy when we went. Joe was awesome and it was really cool to hear the story behind the place. Will definitely return!

Franks is an awesome neighborhood beer bar. It makes me wish I lived near it.

With an awesome homage to the owner’s dog, Frank, there’s a lot of fun pictures around. Beer is fantastic, something for everyone. Wine, N/A, single cans also available.

If he figures out how to squeeze a few more seats in the inside, it’s going to be pretty perfect.

We found this place on an IG post and also a newsletter, The Optimist. Great story about about a neighbor helped save the business from flooding in a torrential rain storm. It's located in East Charlotte off Commonwealth Ave. in a quiet neighborhood. Great neighborhood vibe, super dog friendly, I think we were the only ones that didn't have a dog with us, maybe next time. Great local beer selection on tap, wine and other adult beverages available. Kid friendly, but it is a BAR! The space is small, so the more people, it gets hard to carry on a conversation over music and voices. We have found this a challenge at many venues we go to. Joe was very cool to talk to and made us feel welcomed, we wish them
the best in this cute little bottle shop across fro
m Repo Records. Parking lot is small, neighborhood street parking for free. I feel like a lot of people walk here, wish we could.
Franks Beer shop is the place to be! Great ownership and always keeps the atmosphere light and fun. Would 100% recommend checking it out!

Visited here on a Wednesday and sat at the bar.  We met the owner Joe.  Very friendly place.   Decent beer selection.  We parked on a side road off of Commonwealth near Repo Records. I liked the record player that plays Grateful Dead.  It adds to the awesome chill of the place.  A great place to meet a friend for a drink
Love having Frank’s in the neighborhood! Great beer and ownership. Very family and did friendly. They’ve also got excellent merch!

Super chill laid back spot with a good selection of beer (and wine, kombucha, juice boxes). Thoughtfully put together: We loved petting all the dogs and appreciated the family-friendly touches like coloring pages and sidewalk chalk. We’ll definitely be back. Make sure to check out Repo Records across the street!
Heard great things about this place. Will be bringing my dogs here.
A great neighborhood bar for Commonwealth Park. Great service and dog friendly.
Really comfortable place with a kind owner. Excited to see how things go from here
They have hooks for your bags and other belongings! Such a small detail but just shows how thoughtful the owner is! Great place to hang up your bag and have a drink 🍻
Ran into the employee of the month, Cooper. Great guy, very laid back. 12/10, super happy to have this spot in the neighborhood
worth the planes, trains and automobiles down from NYC. Couldn’t recommend more.
That sign is amazing and so are the owners.
Greatest place ive ever drank a beer. Delightful people running the joint. Beer, coffee, wine, cozy atmosphere and dogs. What more could you want. If they would let me live here i would.
Great people and awesome bar!
Couldn’t recommend this 🫶🏼dog friendly🫶🏼 spot more! Their beer is amazing and their swag is exceptional!
Loving that sign! I’m taking it as a sign I should visit soon 😁
Just saw that amazing sign! I can’t wait to enjoy a cold one with new friends. Welcome to the neighborhood!
The best spot to go to for a drink!  The beer is great and the owners are top notch.. Frank would be proud!
Good beer. Good sign. Good dogs. Sick van
